The usage shape an OpenAI-compatible reading gets wrong. input_tokens counts
only what follows the last cache breakpoint, so billed input is the SUM of
input_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens, and cache_read_input_tokens — and
the cache read is priced at a tenth of the fresh input rate.

Kno never sets cache_control (docs/debt.md#41), so a cache READ can still
happen — the provider caches on its own — while a cache WRITE billed to us
cannot. Recorded because the read path is the one that must not settle at the
fresh input rate.
